title: Data Analyst
description: Master SQL, Python, data visualization, and statistical analysis in 2026.

topics.title: SQL Fundamentals
topics.description: SELECT, WHERE, JOINs, aggregations, and subqueries.
learning_objectives: Write basic and complex SQL queries
Perform INNER, LEFT, and FULL outer joins
Use GROUP BY and aggregate functions

topics.title: Advanced SQL & Window Functions
topics.description: Window functions, CTEs, query optimization, and indexing.
learning_objectives: Apply window functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG, LEAD)
Structure complex queries with Common Table Expressions (CTEs)

topics.title: Python for Data Analytics
topics.description: Python data structures, Jupyter notebooks, and Pandas fundamentals.
learning_objectives: Work with Python data types and list comprehensions
Manipulate tabular data using Pandas DataFrames
Perform data cleaning and handle missing values
